about.name: openGauss
about.description: openGauss is a high-performance, highly secure, highly available, and intelligent enterprise-grade open-source relational database

@graph.name: openGauss SIG List
@graph.description: The complete list of openGauss Special Interest Groups (SIGs), covering 25 SIGs including AI, Blockchain, CloudNative, SQLEngine, StorageEngine, and more.

item.name: AI
item.description: Dedicated to empowering openGauss with AI4DB (autonomous management & self-learning kernel) and DB4AI (in-database algorithms & full-lifecycle AI pipelines).

item.name: Blockchain
item.description: Explores blockchain use cases and technical challenges, including consensus protocols, query processing, privacy protection, and regulatory frameworks.

item.name: Certification
item.description: Evaluates and certifies the capabilities and maturity of openGauss releases.

item.name: CloudNative
item.description: Develops and maintains cloud-native features for openGauss. Mailing list for SIG CloudNative discussion group in openGauss community.

item.name: CM
item.description: Develops and maintains common components such as O&M management, aiming to deliver a universally compatible and easily extensible set of common capabilities.

item.name: Connectors
item.description: Plans, develops, and maintains database drivers, providing efficient drivers tailored to business demands.

item.name: DCF
item.description: Provides a distributed consistency framework for openGauss DN data replication and arbitration, ensuring high availability.

item.name: Docs
item.description: Dedicated to delivering a comprehensive content system, from technical documentation to tutorials, to provide full support for openGauss users and developers.

item.name: Embedded
item.description: Drives the development, environmental tuning, O&M, and release of industrial multi-model embedded databases. We aim to create a lightweight, multi-model (relational, time-series, KV), and high-performance industrial database widely compatible with global OSs.

item.name: GIS
item.description: Geographic Information System (GIS) SIG drives the development and maintenance of the GIS in the openGauss community.

item.name: Graph
item.description: Dedicated to building unified storage and query capabilities for knowledge graph data management. Built on openGauss, we enable shared storage and query interoperability between RDF and property graph models, as well as semantic alignment and syntactic translation between Cypher and SPARQL.

item.name: IoT
item.description: Advances IoT capabilities for openGauss, driving the integration, development, and maintenance of relevant technologies.

item.name: KnowledgeGraph
item.description: Covers the entire knowledge graph lifecycle, from creation and storage management to application.

item.name: oGRAC
item.description: Develops and maintains the oGRAC database, striving to craft a premier open-source, multi-write database solution.

item.name: OM
item.description: Dedicated to the installation and maintenance of openGauss.

item.name: OPS
item.description: Focuses on building robust O&M capabilities for openGauss, improving product maintainability, and transferring operational expertise.

item.name: Plugin
item.description: Builds a multi-layer, multi-method plugin architecture, empowering developers to extend openGauss kernel functionalities across different layers via plugins.

item.name: QA
item.description: Oversees openGauss release quality and enhances the community's testing capabilities.

item.name: ReleaseManagement
item.description: Orchestrates openGauss community releases by collaborating with SIG maintainers to drive the ultimate competitiveness of the project. Key responsibilities: · Define overall testing timelines, release schedules, and milestone targets for openGauss. · Tracks feature delivery status to ensure key features are delivered as planned. · Coordinate product releases across QA, release engineers, and the Technical Committee, and attend related meetings. · Streamline the delivery process for openGauss projects.

item.name: RISC-V
item.description: Implements openGauss and enhances its competitiveness on the RISC-V platform.

item.name: Security
item.description: Addresses and resolves openGauss security issues, offers security guidance to the community, and drives security governance initiatives.

item.name: SecurityTechnology
item.description: Develops and maintains database security features for openGauss to protect database systems from unauthorized access, theft, tampering, and corruption by malicious users.

item.name: SQLEngine
item.description: Aims to deliver a high-performance, highly reliable, and future-proof database storage foundation with openGauss.

item.name: StorageEngine
item.description: Aims to deliver a high-performance, highly reliable, and future-proof database storage foundation with openGauss.

item.name: Tools
item.description: Manages the long-term planning, development, and evolution of the openGauss tool ecosystem.
